scope: Independent code/helper review preserved before inspecting any new-case candidate scores. No production DSP or evaluator edited.

findings.result: The latest evaluator verifies catalog MP3/bank identities, original member hash/name, and source-only reconstruction MP3/SysEx pins before rendering. Each replay receipt is checked against renderer/MIDI/SysEx/output hashes.

Pre-render MIDI is compared with a canonical sibling MIDI when present. Rendered MIDI/SysEx are compared with the pre-render pins. Source time zero retains preceding events. Case IDs are validated before paths are formed.

fit_transform sees only reference/candidate prefixes. The evaluator uses one production-only lag bounded50ms and one prefix RMS gain for every primary candidate. Separately fitted candidate-prefix gains are labelled sensitivities.

For either lag sign, both reference and candidate calibration supports end at or before cal, and both evaluation supports begin at or after cal. STFT boundary=None/padded=False prevents frames from reaching back across the split.

All primary listening signals use the same lag, baseline prefix gain and evaluation slice, then one shared scalar for level and peak management. The evaluation-derived shared listening scalar does not change raw metric comparisons.

assess.measure uses max(reference,candidate) activity masks separately for each pair. Time/channel coverage is common, but active bins can differ for log-spectrum and envelope summaries. A ranking from these masked metrics is not identical-bin evidence. Spectral convergence uses all bins and is unaffected by this mask policy. Consider a common-union-mask sensitivity if masked metrics materially affect a promotion decision.

The evaluator checks frozen files/manifests/binaries against the prior run but does not independently anchor all source bytes to Git b0f6c03 or validate source-manifest.json against that prior run hash. It relies on the previously audited build chain. Parent separately reported gain1 frozen Source equals current Source; independent final-run receipt verification remains pending.

compare_hardware.render_case also emits legacy whole-excerpt listening transforms and working-tree DSP hashes. They are not the prospective prefix transformation or complete candidate build identity. Use the evaluator outer protocol/build manifests and raw audio for conclusions.

Generic boundary validation reserves200ms whereas assess.measure needs250ms after lag trimming, and the fit helper itself needs a longer prefix than the generic100ms minimum. Both frozen current cases pass worst-case50ms coverage. A boundary/unidentifiable alignment flag is retained but does not automatically prevent scoring; inspect it before interpreting alignment-dependent metrics.

synthetic_checks.python_source:
import json
import numpy as np
from assess_hardware_equivalence import fit_transform
sr=1000; n=900; cal=405; rng=np.random.default_rng(278)
t=np.arange(n)/sr
a=(np.exp(-((t-.12)/.025)**2)+.7*np.exp(-((t-.25)/.040)**2)+.25*np.exp(-((t-.35)/.015)**2))*rng.standard_normal(n)
a=np.column_stack((a,.9*a))
rows=[]
for delay in (-50,-37,0,37,50):
    c=np.zeros_like(a)
    if delay>=0: c[delay:]=a[:n-delay]*1.3
    else: c[:delay]=a[-delay:]*1.3
    first=fit_transform(a,c,sr,cal,.05)
    assert first['candidate_lag_samples']==delay
    assert abs(first['candidate_gain']-1/1.3)<1e-12
    ca,cb=max(0,-delay),min(cal,cal-delay)
    start,end=max(cal,cal-delay),min(n,n-delay)
    assert ca>=0 and ca+delay>=0 and cb<=cal and cb+delay<=cal
    assert start>=cal and start+delay>=cal and end<=n and end+delay<=n
    c[cal:]=rng.normal(0,100,c[cal:].shape)
    second=fit_transform(a,c,sr,cal,.05)
    assert first==second
    rows.append(dict(planted_lag_samples=delay,recovered_lag_samples=first['candidate_lag_samples'],recovered_gain=first['candidate_gain'],prefix_reference=[ca,cb],prefix_candidate=[ca+delay,cb+delay],evaluation_reference=[start,end],evaluation_candidate=[start+delay,end+delay],heldout_poison_invariant=True))
print(json.dumps(rows))
